parameters.content:
### 04 Acciones

Bug: issue en el repo de pruebas (sin datos de contacto) y acuse en el hilo.
Urgente: Telegram al momento y acuse.
Lead: se guarda el contacto y el borrador, y llega un aviso a Telegram con la respuesta sugerida. No se envía solo.
Spam: se descarta y se apunta.

Si GitHub falla: `error_accion` y aviso a Telegram.

nodes.name: Configuración
nodes.notes: Valores que se ven en cámara. El .env no entra aquí: Coolify bloquea $env.

parameters.query:
WITH claimed AS (
  UPDATE mail_messages SET status = 'procesando_accion'
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'pendiente' AND route = $2::text
  RETURNING id, message_id, from_address, from_name, subject, body_normalized, draft_reply,
            reasoning, references_header, route, created_at
)
SELECT c.id::text AS id, c.message_id, c.from_address, c.from_name, c.subject, c.body_normalized,
       c.draft_reply, c.reasoning, c.references_header, c.route, c.created_at
FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN claimed c ON true

nodes.name: Reclamar
nodes.notes: pendiente -> procesando_accion. Dos llamadas no abren dos issues.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
SELECT id, 'peticion_ignorada', jsonb_build_object('flujo', $2::text, 'estado', status)
FROM mail_messages WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id

nodes.name: Registrar lead
nodes.notes: El contacto está en la fila. El borrador de seguimiento no se envía solo.

nodes.name: ¿Lead guardado?
nodes.notes: Solo avisa si el UPDATE devolvió id.

nodes.name: Avisar lead
nodes.notes: Aviso al momento, sin botones. Si falla, el lead sigue en lead_registrado y queda error_aviso en mail_actions.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
VALUES ($1::uuid, CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN 'aviso_lead' ELSE 'error_aviso' END,
        CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('flujo', '04 lead', 'error', $3::text) END)
RETURNING id

nodes.name: Anotar aviso lead
nodes.notes: Deja rastro del aviso. Si Telegram falló, el resumen diario sigue contando el lead.

nodes.name: Avisar urgente
nodes.notes: Sale ya. No espera al resumen. Si falla, el acuse sale igual y queda apuntado.

parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE mail_messages
  SET status = 'urgente_avisado',
      final_reply = CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN $2 ELSE final_reply END,
      reply_message_id = NULLIF($4::text, '')
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'procesando_accion'
  RETURNING id
), log AS (
  INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'urgente', jsonb_build_object('telegram', $5::boolean, 'acuse', $3::boolean))
  RETURNING id
), err AS (
  INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
  SELECT $1::uuid, 'error_acuse', jsonb_build_object('error', $6::text, 'telegram', $5::boolean)
  WHERE NOT $3::boolean OR NOT $5::boolean
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM upd) AS id

nodes.name: Issue
nodes.notes: Título y cuerpo con los datos de contacto tapados. Ni remitente ni mailto: el repo puede ser público.

nodes.name: Crear issue
nodes.notes: Token fine-grained, solo issues, repo de pruebas.

nodes.name: Enviar acuse bug
nodes.notes: Acuse con la referencia, sin enlace a GitHub, en el mismo hilo.

parameters.query:
WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE mail_messages
  SET status = 'issue_creada', github_issue_number = $2::int, github_issue_url = $3,
      final_reply = CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN $4 ELSE final_reply END,
      reply_message_id = NULLIF($6::text, '')
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND status = 'procesando_accion'
  RETURNING id
), log AS (
  INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
  VALUES ($1::uuid, 'issue', jsonb_build_object('url', $3::text, 'acuse', $5::boolean))
  RETURNING id
), err AS (
  INSERT INTO mail_actions (mail_id, action, detail)
  SELECT $1::uuid, 'error_acuse', jsonb_build_object('error', $7::text)
  WHERE NOT $5::boolean
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM upd) AS id
